inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: The six-row TERM / DEFINITION / EXAMPLE table (the whole section)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The section's entire printed content, verbatim: header row 'TERM | DEFINITION | EXAMPLE' and six rows — Additive ('Effect of substances A and B together is equal to the sum of their individual effects' / 'Aspirin and acetaminophen “2 + 2 = 4”'), Permissive ('Presence of substance A is required for the full effects of substance B' / 'Cortisol on catecholamine responsiveness'), Synergistic ('Effect of substances A and B together is greater than the sum of their individual effects' / 'Clopidogrel with aspirin “2 + 2 > 4”'), Potentiation ('Similar to synergism, but drug B (with no therapeutic action alone) enhances the therapeutic action of drug A' / 'Carbidopa only blocks enzyme to prevent peripheral conversion of levodopa “2 + 0 > 2”'), Antagonistic ('Effect of substances A and B together is less than the sum of their individual effects' / 'Morphine with naloxone “2 + 2 < 4”'), Tachyphylactic ('Acute decrease in response to a drug after initial/repeated administration' / 'Repeat use of intranasal decongestant (eg, oxymetazoline) → ↓ therapeutic response (with rebound congestion)'). Pure typeset table, no figures.
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (the sign ladder, the permissive and tachyphylactic panels, and the verbatim examples strip of the DrugEffectModificationsMap) + blocks[1] the verbatim table

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 256). The Drug effect modifications section is one typeset table in the PDF text layer — no figures. The table is carried verbatim (ORIGINAL_KYP_ADAPTATION) in the note's table block and re-typeset in the registry visual's panels; short attributed definition sentences and drug pairs, not artwork reproductions. The section prints NO margin mnemonic; the KYP memory layer adds four original codes. The clinical anchors extending past the source page (adrenal-crisis pressor refractoriness, dual antiplatelet therapy, ED naloxone, rhinitis medicamentosa, tachyphylaxis-vs-tolerance) are KYP clinical anchors, flagged wherever they appear. No copyrighted photographs exist on the page; nothing reproduced. EXCLUSION: the 'Autonomic receptors' section on the same page (lower portion — its second banner, its header, and the AUTONOMIC/SOMATIC overview diagram) belongs to the SEPARATE PENDING topic 'autonomic-receptors' and is NOT part of this topic's inventory.
